args.command:
# Remove Docker Desktop application

sudo rm -f /Library/PrivilegedHelperTools/com.docker.vmnetd
echo "✓ LaunchDaemons and helper removed"

# Remove CLI binaries from /usr/local/bin
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/docker
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/docker-credential-desktop
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/docker-credential-osxkeychain
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/kubectl.docker
echo "✓ CLI binaries removed from /usr/local/bin"

# Remove all Docker data (the 21GB one)
rm -rf ~/Library/Containers/com.docker.docker 2>&1 && echo "✓ Containers/com.docker.docker removed" || echo "✗ failed"
rm -rf ~/Library/Application\ Support/Docker\ Desktop 2>&1 && echo "✓ App Support/Docker Desktop removed"
rm -rf ~/Library/Group\ Containers/group.com.docker 2>&1 && echo "✓ Group Containers/group.com.docker removed"

rm -rf ~/.docker 2>&1 && echo "✓ ~/.docker removed"

# Remove docker-credential-gcloud (Homebrew gcloud's docker helper — optional but cleanup)
rm -f /opt/homebrew/bin/docker-credential-gcloud 2>&1
echo "✓ homebrew docker-credential-gcloud removed (will be restored if gcloud updates)"
